algorithm: DreamerV3, TD-MPC2, SAC, PPO; hierarchical variant uses a frozen low-level reaching policy
success_criterion: task-specific 'Target' return thresholds (Table V/VI); push and package have explicit success flags (goal_dist<0.05 / dist<0.1 in code); most tasks scored by return vs Target rather than binary success
headline_metric: average episode return @10M steps (TD-MPC2 @2M) vs per-task Target
headline_value: no manipulation task's average return exceeds its Target (Table V); e.g. push -1251.9+/-659.8 (DreamerV3) vs Target 700; cube 111.2+/-59.9 (DreamerV3) vs Target 370
paper_code_mismatch: Paper's push reward defaults (alpha_s=1000 target-distance weight) differ from the shipped DreamerV3 config (target_dist weight 0.1, success bonus 10); Robotiq gripper named '2F-85' in the main text and '2F-45' in Appendix A; Shadow Hand DoF given as 25 here (with wrist) vs 24 in the vendor spec / plappert_multigoal_2018.
note_gaps: Numeric bar/curve values for Figs. 7 and 9 (hand-ablation and hierarchical-policy results) are not recoverable from the parse; the cube task's code reward returns no success flag, so no in-hand success rate exists in this source.
